divergence: Best candidate is 1072 bytes versus retail 1076. Retail preserves r19-r31 and explicitly copies both count (mr r19,r31) and half-count (mr r20,r30); GC/1.3 preserves r20-r31, emits only the count copy (mr r20,r31), and coalesces the identical half-count live range. The resulting one-register rotation and the unrolled delta-loop scheduling differ. All 13 relocation-bearing instructions and addends are present, but the compiler-generated signed-short-to-float conversion bias targets TU-local @61 instead of retail lbl_80650B98. Under the permitted one-function honest-C scope, merely declaring lbl_80650B98 does not retarget MWCC's synthesized conversion pool; doing so requires externalization/configuration or shared pool ownership, both outside this assignment.
